property_summary: For any deposit d and cashout amount a <= d, a single non-reentrant CashOut by the depositor must return exactly a to the caller with no extra Ether retained beyond the deposit minus a; the buggy version violates this because it performs the external call before reducing the balance, so a one-shot reentrant caller can withdraw more than a.
change_summary: Move the balance-reduction state update from before the external call to after it, allowing reentrant withdrawal with the old balance visible during the call.
